title: Genetic Engineering Will Change Everything Forever – CRISPR
summary: Kurzgesagt's animated explainer on CRISPR gene editing, covering how the technology works and what it could mean for curing disease, designer babies and aging. It frames genetic engineering as an irreversible change coming to humanity.
why: HN commenters hand it out as a quick, accessible primer whenever CRISPR or gene editing comes up.

quote.text: I strongly recommend this quick introduction video from Kurzgesagt on YouTube
